target.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks
target.body:
#110374 is merged; this draft is rebased directly on `main` and contains only the indexed mirror follow-up.

AI-assisted: implemented with Codex. I reviewed the implementation, ran the repository autoreview workflow to a clean result, and verified the exact production owners against current `main`.

## What Problem This Solves

Codex and Copilot transcript mirrors decode every event in a session while holding the session writer lock just to recover idempotency facts, persisted user rows, and Codex message sequencing. A small mirror batch therefore allocates and parses in proportion to the full transcript, including on 100,000-message sessions.

## Why This Change Was Made

The transcript identity indexes now on `main` already own the required facts. This child adds a separate `withSessionTranscriptIndexedWriteLock` SDK function whose context extends the unchanged `withSessionTranscriptWriteLock` context with only three typed reads: supplied-key existence, supplied-key user messages, and the exact indexed message-event count. Codex and Copilot prepare candidate keys before acquiring the lock and query only those facts. No schema, HTTP/SSE, active-memory, cache, raw SQL surface, or generic query abstraction is added.

## User Impact

Large Codex and Copilot sessions can mirror a small batch without decoding the complete transcript under the writer lock. Dedupe identity, gateway user correlation, hooks, sequence assignment, append/update publication, and replacement behavior remain unchanged.

## Changes Walkthrough

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `src/config/sessions/session-accessor.types.ts` | Adds three narrow writer facts |
| `src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-transcript-store.ts` | Implements batched indexed Kysely reads |
| `src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-transcript-write.ts` | Binds facts to writer ownership |
| `src/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime.ts` | Adds the separate indexed lock context and runner |
| `extensions/codex/src/app-server/transcript-mirror.ts` | Replaces full mirror-state scan |
| `extensions/copilot/src/dual-write-transcripts.ts` | Replaces full key scan |
| `src/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime.test.ts` | Proves batching and replacement reset |
| `src/state/sqlite-query-plan.test.ts` | Pins identity/count index plans |
| `extensions/codex/src/app-server/transcript-mirror.test.ts` | Proves concurrent Codex dedupe |
| `extensions/copilot/src/dual-write-transcripts.test.ts` | Proves concurrent Copilot dedupe |
| `scripts/bench-transcript-mirrors.ts` | Adds reproducible production-owner benchmark |
| `docs/plugins/sdk-runtime.md` | Documents indexed write-lock facts |

## Evidence

### Apples-to-apples benchmark

Both revisions ran in clean detached worktrees on the same Blacksmith Testbox lease `tbx_01kxstq13f2qjb6gbktd89njcc` (Linux 6.6.141 x64, Node v24.18.0). The identical candidate benchmark file invoked the real `codexTranscriptMirrorRuntime.mirror` and `dualWriteCopilotTranscriptBestEffort` owners. The harness rejects a supplied source SHA unless it equals the checkout's actual `HEAD`.

- Baseline: current fetched `origin/main` at `923d92bdd0e3ddb978ab566efe29a737dc204edf`
- Candidate: `7a9e6db40674118c235c5baf6fb6aa8aceb8abaa`
- Fixture: 100,000 linear `type=message` events, 64-byte content, one indexed idempotency key per event
- Operation: four supplied messages, two existing and two new
- Warmup/runs: 2 warmups, 12 measured runs per mirror/revision
- Timing: end-to-end owner latency; in this uncontended run it includes lock acquisition/hold and any post-lock publication, so lock hold was not separately instrumented
- Allocation proxy: process `resourceUsage().maxRSS` growth after fixture seeding

| Mirror | Revision | Median | p95 | Max RSS growth |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Codex | current main | 787.916 ms | 827.691 ms | 1,057,688 KiB |
| Codex | candidate | 46.422 ms | 48.570 ms | 2,048 KiB |
| Copilot | current main | 769.497 ms | 827.412 ms | 1,202,856 KiB |
| Copilot | candidate | 43.355 ms | 43.827 ms | 1,792 KiB |

Candidate reduction: Codex median 94.11% (16.97x), p95 94.13% (17.04x), RSS proxy 99.81%; Copilot median 94.37% (17.75x), p95 94.70% (18.88x), RSS proxy 99.85%.

<details>
<summary>Raw latency samples (milliseconds)</summary>

```text
main Codex:     750.449, 820.000, 818.584, 778.525, 797.308, 802.771, 774.695, 726.949, 803.639, 740.711, 827.691, 754.341
candidate Codex: 47.090, 47.424, 46.865, 45.980, 45.821, 45.941, 47.639, 48.570, 47.146, 45.841, 45.551, 45.392
main Copilot:   813.432, 827.412, 766.096, 794.698, 718.712, 728.189, 805.660, 769.264, 763.755, 762.195, 790.775, 769.730
candidate Copilot: 43.733, 43.289, 43.827, 43.392, 43.318, 43.001, 43.148, 43.147, 43.636, 43.460, 43.514, 43.197
```

</details>

Current main decodes 100,000 transcript payloads per operation to build mirror state. Candidate Copilot decodes zero existing transcript payloads for supplied-key existence. Candidate Codex decodes only the one matching persisted user payload in this fixture; its exact message count reads the covering `(session_id, event_type, seq DESC)` identity index without decoding event JSON. Supplied-key queries are batched at 900 keys and seek through `idx_agent_transcript_message_idempotency`; joined user rows use the transcript-event primary key.

### Correctness and contracts

- 63 focused tests passed across SDK facts, query plans, Codex, and Copilot.
- Coverage includes replacement/current-generation reset, >999 supplied keys, exact raw message count, persisted user recovery, concurrent same-key mirrors, hooks, updates, and sequence behavior.
- Query plans prohibit transcript table scans for supplied-key lookups and pin `idx_agent_transcript_message_idempotency`, `idx_agent_transcript_event_sequence`, and the transcript-event primary key.
- Final autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Thermonuclear maintainability review: no structural findings; mirror files are net smaller and ownership remains in the transcript accessor.

Validation commands:

```text
pnpm test src/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime.test.ts src/state/sqlite-query-plan.test.ts extensions/copilot/src/dual-write-transcripts.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/transcript-mirror.test.ts
node scripts/check-changed.mjs
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-transcript-store.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/transcript-mirror.ts
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.scripts.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/bench-scripts.tsbuildinfo
pnpm exec tsx scripts/bench-transcript-mirrors.ts --mirror=codex --source-sha=<checkout-head>
pnpm exec tsx scripts/bench-transcript-mirrors.ts --mirror=copilot --source-sha=<checkout-head>
```

`check:changed` passed formatting, schema/API baselines, SDK surface/boundaries, and all core/extension/script typechecks. Its conservative parent-inclusive core lint fan-out found one unnecessary numeric conversion in this child; that was removed, and the affected lint target plus focused SDK/Codex tests then passed.

### Upstream Codex protocol check

Personally inspected official Codex at `2895d82b5e449407712439ba4f89954f3fa0c7e3`:

- `codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/thread.rs:1353-1365` — `thread/read` parameters and response
- `codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/thread_data.rs:170-267` — thread turns/items/status contract
- `codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/item.rs:227-250,797-826` — stable user/agent message ids and projection
- `codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs:2255-2379` — persisted/live thread read and `includeTurns` history load
- `codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/turn.rs:407-410` — completed turn payload

These contracts confirm the mirror must preserve stable user/assistant item identity and ordered turn item projection; this child changes only OpenClaw persistence lookup work.
